rationale: PCA scores 5 because TTS and voice-cloning APIs (ElevenLabs, OpenAI TTS) reduce podcast-quality audio production from hours of recording/editing to a single API call at near-zero marginal cost. DDI scores 4 because while some spectral and prosody-based detectors exist, they degrade substantially under voice-cloning fine-tuned on target speakers and across compression codecs used by Spotify/podcast apps. EDP scores 4 due to high harm potential from cloned-voice disinformation (impersonating politicians, executives, or family members in voice messages), though saturation of generic AI podcast content poses lower systemic risk than deepfake audio in high-stakes contexts.
